resources.string: ClipFloat uses the Accessibility Service solely to detect the active text input field and safely paste staged clipboard slots into forms without context-switching. ClipFloat does NOT read, collect, or transmit any keystrokes or personal data.

ClipFloat uses Android's Accessibility API for the sole purpose of assisting users in inserting multi-slot clipboard payloads directly into active form fields.

• Zero Network Access: ClipFloat does NOT declare internet permission.
• Zero Logging: No keystrokes or typed characters are collected, analyzed, or stored.
• Local RAM Only: Clipboard registers exist solely in volatile memory.
ClipFloat requires the overlay permission to display the floating multi-slot clipboard HUD over third-party applications.
